subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated browser microphone-audio RPC?
rationale: Code review can validate the implementation shape, but accepting microphone audio from the browser into Gateway STT providers is a product and security-boundary decision that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue after proof and port
options.body: Require the branch or a replacement to port onto current `ui/src/pages/chat`, fix the alert and docs-map defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue and this PR open while maintainers decide the Control UI dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If core dictation is not wanted now or maintainers prefer a fresh implementation, close this branch and route future work through the paired issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and port
recommendation.body: Require the branch or a replacement to port onto current `ui/src/pages/chat`, fix the alert and docs-map defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal from the prior server-side dictation implementation and is also the clearest product-direction owner from repository maintainer docs.
